description: A PostHog product tour: a sequence of in-app steps (tooltips, modals, banners) shown by posthog-js to targeted users.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the product tour belongs to.

Content.description: Tour content as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString). It holds the tour `steps` (each with its type, target selector, title and body) and display settings such as `appearance`.

TargetingFlagFilters.description: Targeting as a JSON feature-flag filters object (use Fn::ToJsonString), e.g. {"groups": [{"properties": [{"key": "plan", "value": ["pro"], "operator": "exact", "type": "person"}], "rollout_percentage": 100}]}. PostHog keeps it on an internal targeting flag.

LinkedFlagId.description: ID of a feature flag linked to the tour: the tour is shown only to users with the flag enabled.

AutoLaunch.description: Whether posthog-js launches the tour automatically for matching users.

StartDate.description: ISO 8601 launch time. Setting it launches the tour.

EndDate.description: ISO 8601 end time. Setting it stops the tour.

InternalTargetingFlagId.description: ID of the internal targeting flag PostHog manages for the tour.
